items.title: Irwin Leclere Interview, 1970-04-14
items.q: Interviewer: '...did you know Jack Lane...?' Interviewee: 'yeah strangest thing we lived in two houses for over 60 years'

ctx.x: know one no from another just as I say I that my cousin used to play a little piano now and then and I just took it up from then yeah and I wish I could think of this fella that taught me that maple leaf rag one of the most difficult things to play and that's the first thing I learned wasn't that the strangest thing yeah that is you'd think you'd pick out something that's similar you know something simple rather and uh don't know I didn't learn to maple leaf rag one of this and he was he played it marvelously…

oh I see yeah well you weren't too far from Jack Lane did you know Jack Lane Papa Lane they call him he had a band he had several bands going I remember it's just familiar to me yeah I didn't know if you played with him yeah he was popular before world war one
yeah strangest thing we lived in two houses for over 60 years
